title: Database Maintenance
subtitle: Reset user and catalogue data while retaining the database schema and operational records
warning_body: This break-glass operation permanently clears user accounts and user-owned catalogue data, along with records directly tied to them:
warning_item_quotes: Quotes, authors, references, tags, and their enrichment state
warning_item_users: User accounts, sessions, API keys, collections, and likes
warning_item_interactions: Quote-linked views, reports, messages, and social queue/posts
warning_item_moderation: Attributions, enrichment proposals, and history for cleared entities
warning_final: Import/export logs and archives, harvest history, themes, settings, and general activity logs are preserved. Archives may still contain copies of cleared data. USER_PASSWORD must be configured to recreate the admin safely.
dialog_confirm_body: You are about to permanently delete user accounts and catalogue content. This cannot be undone.
dialog_item_all_data: User accounts, catalogue content, and directly linked records will be cleared
dialog_item_schema: The database schema (tables, indexes, triggers) will remain intact
dialog_item_admin: A new admin account will be created using configured credentials
dialog_item_logout: Your current session will be signed out
dialog_checkbox_understand: I understand that user accounts and content will be permanently deleted
error_message: Database reset failed. Please try again.
